claims.claim: Eaton's Q2 2026 sales reached a record $8.5B, up 21% year over year with 14% organic growth; Electrical Americas rolling orders rose 41% organically and backlog rose 33%, while Electrical Global rolling orders rose 33% and backlog rose 103%.

factors.name: power infrastructure demand
factors.basis: order and backlog acceleration across electrical segments indicates sustained electrification and data-center infrastructure demand

risks.risk: Electrical demand can normalize and acquisition integration can dilute incremental returns.

causalEdges.mechanism: new and upgraded facilities require power distribution, protection and thermal/electrical infrastructure
causalEdges.falsifier: electrical orders/backlog contract despite sustained load growth

unknowns.unknown: Exact data-center share of backlog is not disclosed in the cited release.

claims.claim: Q2 segment margin was 23.1%; operating cash flow was $1.1B and free cash flow $874M, up 23% and 22% year over year. Eaton raised 2026 organic-growth guidance to 11-13% and adjusted EPS guidance to $13.40-$13.60.

factors.name: execution and cash conversion
factors.basis: record sales, cash-flow growth and raised organic-growth guidance show demand translating into operating results

risks.risk: Segment margin was lower year over year despite strong growth, making mix and integration execution important.

causalEdges.mechanism: volume growth and operating leverage support operating and free cash flow
causalEdges.falsifier: cash conversion weakens materially while sales growth remains elevated

unknowns.unknown: No valuation conclusion is asserted by Scout.
